analyst_view.overall: Stuttgart lost a heated 2-0 game at Galatasaray in the Champions League on Tuesday, though they created plenty (Leweling hit the post twice), and Hoeneß says some rotation is possible. Bremen are 5th, unbeaten in seven and six points ahead of Stuttgart, with Füllkrug the league's top scorer. Bremen are missing eight senior players, but Niklas Stark (listed as out on the site) is not on their absentee list and may return. Karazor is a doubt after a knock in Istanbul.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Bremen arrive with a depleted squad but in form behind Füllkrug, and Stuttgart's midfield is thin without Stiller and possibly Karazor, which tends to open games up. We lean slightly higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.6 corners. Stuttgart should have most of the ball at home, which the numbers already reflect, so we stay level.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.1 cards, already a high figure. We found nothing on referee Sören Storks or on bad blood between the clubs that would push it further.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.9 shots. Stuttgart created a lot even in defeat in Istanbul and won 4-2 at Leverkusen last time out in the league, and Bremen like to counter through Füllkrug, so we lean a little higher.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.0 shots on target. Possible rotation after the midweek game cuts against the higher shot count, so we stay level.
